blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A Davao City land assessor testified that a property owned by Atty. Manases Carpio, which was supposedly not declared by his wife, Vice President Sara Duterte, was actually listed in her Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth (SALN). During the resumption of Duterte’s impeachment trial on Monday, defense counsel Lindon Bacquel asked their first witness, Davao City Assessor Engr. Jaime Adalin, if he could identify properties in Duterte’s SALN, given his familiarity with filing asset declarations as a public official. Private prosecutor Benjamin Tolosa Jr. objected, arguing that Adalin could not give an expert opinion on the […]...
